description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for representing savings account transactions in the Apache Fineract system, including transaction details such as date, amount, payment info, account ID, and deposit type.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionDTO
classes.description: A DTO encapsulating details of a savings account transaction, used for bulk deposit transactions within the Fineract system.

methods.name: SavingsAccountTransactionDTO
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a savings account transaction data object with transaction details: formatter, date, amount, payment info, account ID, and deposit type.

methods.name: getFormatter
methods.description: Returns the date formatter used for formatting transaction dates.

methods.name: getTransactionDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the transaction.

methods.name: getTransactionAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the transaction.

methods.name: getPaymentDetail
methods.description: Returns the payment detail associated with the transaction.

methods.name: getSavingsAccountId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the savings account related to this transaction.

methods.name: getAccountType
methods.description: Returns the deposit account type for the transaction.
